blurb: They are proud to call this town “my town”. Rocanville is located in south-eastern Saskatchewan near the Qu’appelle Valley and Manitoba border. A town rich in history, a booming potash industry and a beautiful 13 building museum which acts as the cultural “hub”. Join Kevin Power has he attends the Rocanville market at the museum which is held once a month during the summer.
